commands.install_python: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install flask flask-cors  # nuts_calc_tex.py itself needs no pip packages, only pdflatex/lualatex on PATH
commands.run_cli: cd backend && python3 nuts_calc_tex.py <paper_size> <command> [options]  # requires pdflatex/lualatex; backend/app.py selects it via NUTS_CALC_RENDERER (default latex)

notes.package_manager: No requirements.txt/pyproject.toml/setup.py exists for the Python side (a prior setup.py was removed per commit d9fc0a3, verified: 'git log -- backend/nuts_calc.py', when nuts_calc.py itself still existed pre-#232). README.md's Setup/Dependencies sections describe installing Flask/Flask-Cors manually via pip; nuts_calc_tex.py itself (the sole CLI since issue #232 removed nuts_calc.py/reportlab) has zero pip dependencies, only pdflatex/lualatex on PATH. frontend/web has its own independent package.json/package-lock.json for npm (frontend/spa, its former sibling, was removed in issue #233).
notes.ci: No .github/workflows directory or other CI definition exists in this repo (verified: 'find .github -type f' returns nothing).
notes.restructure_issue_88: The repo was reorganized in issue #88 from a web/{backend,frontend} layout to backend/ + frontend/{spa,web}, consolidating nuts_calc.py/nuts_calc_tex.py/factory.sh/vendor/texmf/tests/pytest.ini (previously at the repo root and web/backend/) into a single self-contained backend/ tree, moving the existing React SPA unchanged from web/frontend to frontend/spa, and adding frontend/web as a new lightweight, Japanese-only, no-i18n-library static multi-page implementation (HTML/CSS(Sass)/JS via Vite) that shares the same backend/ Flask API. backend/renderers.py's script-path resolution was updated accordingly (self-relative to backend/ instead of two levels up from web/backend/). frontend/spa itself was removed entirely in issue #233, leaving frontend/web as the sole Web UI frontend under backend/ + frontend/{web}.
notes.tests: backend/tests/ contains 26 Python test_*.py files (backend/pytest.ini: testpaths=tests, pythonpath=.); all 808 tests passed on 2026-08-21, including available pdflatex/lualatex-gated tests. frontend/web has 3 node:test files (59 tests total, including vite.config.test.js); all passed when invoked explicitly. It defines no npm test script. Issue #98 rebuilt frontend/web's drillPresets.js as a grade -> category -> menu-item model, so it no longer copies the former frontend/spa's version (frontend/spa was removed entirely in issue #233).
notes.known_defects: frontend/web has no lint script configured. (frontend/spa formerly had one known no-irregular-whitespace lint failure in drillPresets.js; moot since frontend/spa was removed in issue #233.)
notes.nuts_calc_tex_py: The sole PDF-generation CLI/renderer since issue #232 removed nuts_calc.py (ReportLab), which it never shared code with. It implements 20 commands: seven commands with 1:1 semantics to the removed nuts_calc.py, plus fraction, mixed-number, comparison, number-property, LCM/GCD, and fraction/decimal conversion commands. The ope command supports decimals, carry/borrowing, remainders, multiple expression shapes, and a reusable --result-max ceiling. Requires pdflatex or (default) lualatex, and vendors longdivision under backend/vendor/texmf/. backend/renderers.py selects it via NUTS_CALC_RENDERER (default latex); the renderer-switching mechanism itself is kept for a possible future renderer even though nuts_calc.py/reportlab is gone.
notes.generate_problems_endpoint: backend/app.py exposes a third endpoint, POST /generate-problems (issue #138), alongside POST /generate-pdf and GET /renderer-info. It accepts paper_size/command_type/num and returns JSON problem data ({'problems': [...]}) without generating a PDF, by calling backend/problem_generation.py's in-process wrappers around nuts_calc_tex.py's data-generation functions (no subprocess). It supports 19 of nuts_calc_tex.py's 20 commands (100 is excluded, see docs/L3_implementation/api.md and backend/problem_generation.py's module docstring for why). frontend/web's preset.html detail screen (frontend/web/src/presetDetail.js, issue #139/#177) uses it to replace static example chips with live-generated ones for eligible ope variants, debounced 300ms; the former frontend/spa (removed in issue #233) never used this endpoint. See docs/L3_implementation/api.md.
